name: PlayableWorldAI
tagline: Turn a sentence or photo into a walkable 3D world you can export.
description: AI World Generator powered by World Labs Marble. Turn a sentence or a photo into a playable 3D world you can walk through, then export it to Unity, Unreal or Blender. Free tier: 30 one-time credits for the entry image model only; no 3D worlds. 3D worlds require the paid Starter plan or credit packs. Genie 4 is waitlist only.
